description: This file is a fuzzing test for the net::HttpServer component, involving a delegate class that handles HTTP and WebSocket events, and a main function that sets up the server with fuzzed input data.

classes.name: WaitTillHttpCloseDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for net::HttpServer that manages connection events, HTTP requests, WebSocket requests, and WebSocket messages, with configurable actions based on fuzzed input.

methods.name: set_server
methods.description: Sets the server instance that the delegate interacts with.

methods.name: OnConnect
methods.description: Handles new connection events, closing the connection if not accepted.

methods.name: OnHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, optionally replying with a 200 response.

methods.name: OnWebSocketRequest
methods.description: Handles WebSocket upgrade requests, accepting or closing based on flags.

methods.name: OnWebSocketMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, optionally replying.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, triggers the completion callback.
